guide.text: Wonder Woman Death Metal's signature gear. Grants a brief window where no Energy is consumed, allowing her to safely enter ultimate form and unleash her full combo. Basic attacks deal bonus damage based on the target's max HP, making it ideal for countering tanky enemies. After casting her Ultimate, she gains a shield to maintain her momentum.
